title: The Rotting Grasp Course
summary: A course for those past the primers on seizing a foe and letting a sour rot run up the held limb.

title: A Treatise on the Waning Guard
summary: A treatise on guards that let the force of a blow wane into the user's body and leave the striker weakened.

title: Manual of the Ashfall Easing
summary: A manual on letting a poison or taint run out of the body as grey ash and teaching the death-aligned to ease it from others.

title: The Entropy Hand Compendium
summary: A compendium on hastening the age of wood and cloth and iron and flesh with a hand charged by the end of cycles.

title: The Sapping Current Course
summary: A course on drawing vitality off a foe in a steady current and sending it down to be spent.

title: Canon of the Slow Cessation
summary: A canon of the patient style that does not kill with hate but lets each function of the foe come to its end.

title: Treatise of the Last Exhale
summary: A treatise on the long out-breath that carries a foe's strength away and bears the sickness out of a friend.
